subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Villain Problem
description: A quick, practical guide to The Villain Problem.

hook.text: A hero is only as compelling as the villain they face.

buildup.text: Great villains believe they're the hero of their own story. Their logic is airtight.

discovery.text: Thanos wanted to save the universe. Killmonger wanted justice. Both had a point.

twist.text: Weak villains who are 'just evil' make the hero's victory feel hollow.

climax.text: The Joker works because he's philosophically opposed to Batman, not just physically.

punchline.text: The best villain almost convinces you.

quiz.question: What makes a villain compelling in screenwriting?
options: Having a worldview that makes logical sense to them
